versions.changelog:
work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper 0.1.0

- Initial release focused on supporting Gog-style workflow needs for Google Workspace users.
- Provides structured, locally-executable workflow assistance for bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvement, and adjacent skill creation.
- Delivers customizable plans, templates, checklists, and implementation support with local hardware-friendly approaches.
- Adds automated clarification step: only requests additional information if it will change the outcome.
- Ensures outputs are actionable, validated, and include clear usage or follow-up notes.
